normalization: Files as fetched. Internet Archive OCR text layers as fetched, uncorrected (text/<slug>.ocr.txt); the scan under original/ is the witness. Library of Congress and FAMSI PDFs are image files without a text layer: the page is the only reading.
scope: The twelve books whole, in the twelve parts the World Digital Library publishes (the introduction and indices travel with Book I): the Nahuatl in the right column, Sahagún's Spanish in the left, with its paintings. The single-file copy of the whole (LoC item 2021667837, 167.9 MB) exceeds the repository's file limit and is named at its origin. Dibble and Anderson's edition and translation (1950–82) is in copyright and is not seated.
why_seated: The largest record of a Mesoamerican world in its own language: the gods, the ceremonies, the calendar and divination, rhetoric and moral philosophy (the huehuetlatolli), the natural world, and Book XII, the conquest of Mexico as the Nahua told it. Seated beside the Maya books as the Nahuatl witness of the same continent.
ruling: Lee Sharks, 2026-10-23: "detour for an ea-corpora searing. lets see. whats available of mayan texts? and then i dont think we have much or any deteurocanonical second temple lit - all those apocalypses. and what about the ethiopian canon? and euclid. all in original language or as close to it as possible. what else?" — "and the Egyptian book of the dead" — "and what about the fragments of the book of baalim? i might be miswriting this. recent discovery. if theyre available anywhere." — "yes yes yes to all - what a meal."
